description: Four units whose primary lossless channel set states downmix type 7, which Table 8-8 does not use.

crosscheck.decode_error: Invalid XLL primary channel set downmix type

skip.ffprobe_bitrate: ffmpeg's lossless decoder sets the bit rate to 0 (dca_xll.c: avctx->bit_rate = 0), so ffprobe lists none
skip.ffprobe_profile: ffmpeg names the lossless profile when its decoder has decoded a frame (dca_xll.c), which it does not here, so ffprobe names the core's
skip.decode: ffmpeg's decoder refuses downmix type 7 (dca_xll.c: 'Invalid XLL primary channel set downmix type')
